title: Token bucket: burst followed by refill
method: Synthetic deterministic exercise: capacity 40 tokens, refill 10 tokens/second, each export costs 5 tokens. Initially full; spend all available tokens at t=0,1,2. Counts are admission allowances, not throughput or customer measurements.
alt: Token bucket: burst followed by refill. Illustrative values: At 0 seconds 8 exports, At 1 second 2 exports, At 2 seconds 2 exports.
